description: Get one Mandarin grammar point by its slug. Returns the written explanation, worked example sentences with pinyin and English, a word-by-word note for each word in the pattern (what it does, structure, three examples, a common mistake), the grammar points that should be learned first, and the points this one leads to. Use this after search_grammar, when the user wants a pattern explained or wants to know what to study before it. Do not guess a slug: get it from search_grammar or get_grammar_order.
name: get_grammar_point
title: Get one Chinese grammar point
